posts.title: I Watched Project Hail Mary (2026)
posts.description: Context note: between watching Project Hail Mary and publishing this review of it, I read the novel it was adapted from. posts.title: I Watched Nobody (2021)
posts.description: 2021’s Nobody is a candy bar action flick of the highest order. I will admit, this is more a Tony’s Chocolonely rather than a Hershey’s bar, but it is still a sweet treat rather than a film with any substance. I can’t remember when I originally watched it, but I recently rewatched it whilst visiting family, and I don’t think my opinion of the film was helped by it being a second viewing. Bob Odenk
